headline: Siddharth Jain files substantial acquisition disclosure in GFL Limited under SEBI Takeover Regs
sum: Siddharth Jain has filed a Regulation 10(5) disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in GFL Limited with NSE. The filing marks the formal commencement of takeover obligations under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011.
implication: Regulation 10(5) disclosure triggers mandatory open offer obligations if acquisition breaches 25% threshold; acquirer must publish detailed offer document within prescribed timelines and adhere to valuation norms under Schedule II.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations 2011, Reg 10(5) requires disclosure of substantial acquisition when a person acquires shares crossing thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, etc.). Siddharth Jain's filing on 17 Aug 2026 indicates either initial threshold crossing or intent to acquire a controlling stake. The disclosure is filed with NSE, the primary exchange for GFL Limited.
